svg.text: 6 relations; 53 attributes; 7 declared foreign keys. Each relation is one horizontal attribute row.
Underlined = primary key; coloured italic = foreign key; arrow points from FK to referenced key. UQ identifies a unique combination.
Only declared database FKs receive arrows. Exact types, nullability and logical-reference notes are in RELATIONAL_MAPPING.md.
Source: actual website PostgreSQL meridian:5432. Grey external rows show only referenced primary keys.
Composite uniqueness applies to the whole listed combination; it does not make each component individually unique.
